description:
Search parks, beaches, trails, hotels, campgrounds and cabin resorts in California and Nevada by name, location and dog rules.

Returns one page of places with a one-line answer ("Yes, on a leash no longer than 6 feet."), status (yes, yes_restricted, no, varies), verification date and page URL. Each result includes the place id.

Examples:
  - "Off-leash beaches near San Diego" -> type="beach", off_leash=true, near={lat:32.72, lon:-117.16}
  - "Can I bring my dog to Point Lobos?" -> query="Point Lobos"
  - "State parks in Marin County that allow dogs" -> type="park", county="Marin", dogs_allowed=true
  - "Lake Tahoe beaches in Nevada that allow dogs" -> type="beach", state="NV", dogs_allowed=true
  - "Off-leash dog parks in Las Vegas" -> type="park", off_leash=true, county="Clark", state="NV"
  - "RV parks in Fresno County that take dogs" -> type="campground", county="Fresno", dogs_allowed=true
  - "Dog-friendly cabins in June Lake" -> type="cabins", query="June Lake", dogs_allowed=true
  - "Restaurants with a dog-friendly patio in Alameda" -> type="restaurant", query="Alameda"

area.description: Area id, the name a traveler gives the trip: san-francisco, east-bay, peninsula, south-bay, north-bay, lake-tahoe, big-sur, mendocino-coast, yosemite, death-valley

county.description: County name without "County", in California or Nevada, e.g. "Monterey" or "Washoe"

dogs_allowed.description: true: only places that allow dogs somewhere; false: only places that do not

near.description: Limit to places near a point; results are sorted by distance

off_leash.description: true: only places where the managing agency allows dogs off leash, at least at some times

query.description: Words to match in the name, city, county or brand

region.description: Region id, e.g. central-coast, san-diego or reno-tahoe-nevada

response_format.description: 'markdown' for readable text, 'json' for structured data

state.description: "CA" or "NV". Also tells apart counties with the same name, such as Humboldt.

type.description: Kind of place; campground covers campgrounds and RV parks (some also rent cabins), cabins covers cabin resorts with no campground, restaurant covers restaurants, cafes, bars, breweries and tasting rooms (dogs on the patio, by the owner's published policy)

name: dogpolicies_search_places

citation.description: Copy-ready citation: answer, source, date checked, record URL, license

confidence.description: stated: the place's own source says it; inferred_from_agency: an agency-wide rule; inherited_brand: the chain's policy, not confirmed by this hotel

freshness.description: fresh: inside its review interval; due: past it; stale: past twice it, confirm before you go; unreadable: the last check could not read the source

uid.description: Stable id that survives a rename

title: Search places
